note: On Lake Sharpe (Missouri River), 35 mi SE of Pierre off SD-34. Electric sites in several loops, non-electric sites at the west end and four camping cabins; the shore loop's outer row (sites 45E-59E, odd numbers) is the one on the water. Protected boat harbor and ramp, swim beach, fish-cleaning station, bike and fishing-pole checkout; seasonal boat and camper storage. --Claude
